description: Apply article 50A of the Assessment and Collection of Taxes Law N.4/1978 to a late filing or late payment and return the charge. Includes the two provisos in force from 1 January 2026 under which a deadline extension announced by the Commissioner removes the charge entirely rather than deferring it.

after_a_formal_notice_from_the_commissio.description: A notice allowing not less than 60 days was served and not complied with.

filed_within_announced_extension.description: Filed inside a deadline the Commissioner announced publicly.

tax_due.description: Tax unpaid at the deadline, for the payment charge.

tax_paid_at_submission.description: The tax shown on the return was paid when the return was submitted.

turnover_or_assets_over_1m.description: Companies above one million euro of turnover or assets carry the higher charge.

name: cyprus_late_filing_charge
title: Calculate the charge for filing or paying Cyprus tax late
